# meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_events_defer (Resource)

This resource can manage the `Network Firmware Upgrades Staged Events Defer` configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "meraki_network_firmware_upgrades_staged_events_defer" "example" {
  network_id = "L_123456"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) Network ID

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object
